profile.summary: Inspection Services, Inc. (ISI) is a company that provides special inspection and materials testing services for construction projects, to help make sure they meet codes, specifications and safety standards. It has operated since 1995 and serves sectors such as municipal infrastructure, educational facilities, healthcare, and residential and commercial construction.
